fands.question: Can I save passwords in this app?
fands.answer: Yes, you can save passwords at any time on your device.

fands.question: What if autofill is not working on websites?
fands.answer: Go to your default browser > Settings > Autofill service, and select 'Autofill using another service' or enable the third-party autofill option.

fands.question: Will I lose my data?
fands.answer: Yes, all local data will be permanently deleted when you remove the app.

fands.question: Can I re-download it later?
fands.answer: Yes, you can reinstall it anytime from the store.

fands.question: Can I export and import my saved accounts?
fands.answer: Yes, you can import or export your accounts using a TXT file.

fands.question: Can I manually generate many passwords at once?
fands.answer: Yes, you can generate multiple passwords at once and use them to manually add accounts. The passwords will be saved with the accounts.
